title: Loop of the Recursive Dragon — Computing Concepts, Chapters 1-3: Foundations & Python Basics
intro_html:
A free quiz-RPG for an introductory computing course, chapters 1-3: Foundations & Python Basics. Battle monsters by answering questions about what computing is and how algorithms work, machine architecture and how a processor runs instructions, and Python basics: variables, types, and input and output.

Pick a set below to begin. Your progress is recorded in this course's gradebook.
